marketing_description: The Philips LED Filament Bulb is a 2700K warm white bulb with an 800 lm output, using 8 W of power. This Energy Star Certified and Title 20 Compliant bulb has a medium E26 base and a clear glass finish, with a 300 deg beam angle. It is equivalent to a 75 W incandescent bulb and has an average life of 15000 hr.
